item.text: The records distinguish document-list status from source-verified decisions. I’ll use disposition records marked `source_verified` with scope `whole_target`, and get each decision’s meeting from its linked event. Clause links name exact sections; I’ll flag where including descendant clauses would change the answer.

item.text: Four named CRs have no recorded pack membership, and each has a source-verified `withdrawn` decision, so their answers will be empty row lists. Two clause questions have different results if subclauses are included; I’ll use exact clause links and record the broader reading in their notes.

I interpreted the JSON-LD records as linked documents, decision events, dispositions, meetings, CR packs, and specification sections. Qualifying dispositions required `evidenceStatus: source_verified` and assessment scope `whole_target`; their linked decision events supplied the RAN5 meetings. Pack membership supplied plenary details, explicit modification links supplied clauses, and forward revision links supplied later versions. Release filters used each CR’s `targetRelease`.
